title: Time, Days and Dates
context: Times, days and dates come up all day: when a class starts, when a shop opens, when your birthday is. Learn the short patterns and you can use them for anything.
contextPersian: ساعت، روز و تاریخ در طول روز بارها لازم می‌شوند: کلاس کِی شروع می‌شود، مغازه کِی باز می‌شود، تولدت کِی است. الگوهای کوتاه را یاد بگیر و برای همه چیز از آن‌ها استفاده کن.

expressions.example: Excuse me, what time is it? — It's ten past four.
expressions.examplePersian: ببخشید، ساعت چند است؟ — چهار و ده دقیقه است.

expressions.example: It's half past three, so we have time.
expressions.examplePersian: ساعت سه و نیم است، پس وقت داریم.

expressions.example: It's a quarter to nine. We're late!
expressions.note: A quarter past = :15, a quarter to = :45.

expressions.example: What time does the class start? — At seven o'clock.
expressions.examplePersian: کلاس ساعت چند شروع می‌شود؟ — ساعت هفت.

expressions.example: The train leaves at six o'clock.
expressions.note: Use at with clock times: at six, at noon.

expressions.example: I have English class on Monday and Wednesday.
expressions.examplePersian: من دوشنبه و چهارشنبه کلاس انگلیسی دارم.
expressions.note: Use on with days and dates: on Friday, on May 5th.

expressions.example: I drink tea in the morning.
expressions.note: Also: in the afternoon, in the evening, but at night.

expressions.example: What's the date today? — It's the twelfth of June.
expressions.examplePersian: امروز چندم است؟ — دوازدهم ژوئن است.

expressions.example: My birthday is on the fifth of May.
expressions.examplePersian: تولد من پنجم ماه مه است.

expressions.example: How old are you? — I'm twenty-five.
expressions.examplePersian: چند سالته؟ — بیست و پنج سال دارم.
expressions.note: We say I am 25 (not I have 25 years).

expressions.example: Can we meet at eight on Friday?
expressions.examplePersian: می‌شود جمعه ساعت هشت همدیگر را ببینیم؟

options: The class starts on Monday at seven.
The class starts at Monday on seven.
The class starts in Monday at seven.
The class starts on Monday in seven.
exercises.explanationPersian: on با روز، at با ساعت.

commonErrors.feedback: With 'it / the film' we use does.
commonErrors.feedbackPersian: با it و the film از does استفاده می‌کنیم.

exercises.explanation: Questions about time: What time does it start?
exercises.explanationPersian: برای پرسیدن ساعت: What time does it start؟

exercises.explanation: We say in the morning, in the afternoon, in the evening.
exercises.explanationPersian: می‌گوییم in the morning و in the evening.
برای ساعت از at استفاده می‌کنیم.

commonErrors.feedback: We ask: What time is it?

exercises.explanation: Both 'What time is it?' and 'What's the time?' are natural.
exercises.explanationPersian: هر دو What time is it? و What's the time? طبیعی‌اند.

exercises.source: من بیست و پنج سال دارم.

commonErrors.feedback: We do not say 'I have 25 years'. We say: I'm 25.
commonErrors.feedbackPersian: نمی‌گوییم I have 25 years. می‌گوییم: I'm 25.

exercises.explanation: In English we use be for age: I am 25.
exercises.explanationPersian: در انگلیسی برای سن از be استفاده می‌کنیم: I am 25.

exercises.source: می‌شود جمعه ساعت هشت همدیگر را ببینیم؟
acceptedAnswers: Can we meet at eight on Friday?
Can we meet on Friday at eight?
Can we meet at eight o'clock on Friday?
Could we meet at eight on Friday?
Could we meet on Friday at eight?

commonErrors.feedbackPersian: برای روزها از on استفاده می‌کنیم: on Friday.

exercises.explanation: Can we meet at + time on + day?
exercises.explanationPersian: Can we meet at + ساعت on + روز؟

exercises.prompt: The English class starts at 7:15 and finishes at 8:45. When does it finish?
acceptedAnswers: It finishes at a quarter to nine
exercises.explanationPersian: ۸:۴۵ همان a quarter to nine است.

exercises.incorrectSentence: My birthday is in fifth of May.
acceptedAnswers: My birthday is on the fifth of May.
My birthday is on May fifth.
My birthday is on May the fifth.
exercises.explanationPersian: برای تاریخ از on استفاده می‌کنیم.

exercises.audioText: What time does the class start?
acceptedAnswers: What time does the class start?
What time does the class start

speakingTask.instruction: Ask for the time, say when your class starts and say when your birthday is.
speakingTask.instructionPersian: ساعت را بپرس، بگو کلاس تو کِی شروع می‌شود و تولدت کِی است.
modelSentences: Excuse me, what time is it?
My English class starts at seven o'clock on Monday.
My birthday is on the fifth of May.

roleplay.aiRole: A new friend you are planning to meet this week
roleplay.objective: Agree on a day and a time to meet
roleplay.context: You and a new friend want to meet this week. Ask what day and what time is good, say when you are busy, and agree on a plan. Use simple times and days.
roleplay.opening: Hi! Do you want to meet this week? What day is good for you?
